name: pahaadpath
description: Hill-road landslide, traffic and entry-rule advisory for Uttarakhand

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p vendor && cd vendor && npm pack leaflet@1.9.4 qrcode-generator@1.4.4 && for f in *.tgz; do mkdir -p ${f%.tgz} && tar xzf $f -C ${f%.tgz}; done
scripts.test: node tests/matrix.js $PWD/dist/PahaadPath.html && node tests/textaudit.js $PWD/dist/PahaadPath.html && node tests/features.js $PWD/dist/PahaadPath.html && node tests/features2.js $PWD/dist/PahaadPath.html && node tests/features3.js $PWD/dist/PahaadPath.html && node tests/features4.js $PWD/dist/PahaadPath.html && node tests/features5.js $PWD/dist/PahaadPath.html
scripts.test:py: cd python && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
